construction.implementation_origin: New standalone implementation using clearly labeled synthetic fixtures

input.query: String up to 500 characters; blank/stop-word-only queries browse
input.products: At most 1000 objects with unique nonempty id, name, description, category, finite nonnegative price <= 1e12, boolean in_stock, and string-array tags
input.filters: Optional case-insensitive exact category, inclusive min_price/max_price, exact boolean in_stock
input.fixture_label: Nonempty data provenance label; supplied example explicitly synthetic

shared_schema.result: Original product, integer relevance score, per-term match explanations
shared_schema.validation: Single validate() boundary shared by search() and CLI; unknown fields, duplicate IDs, invalid types/ranges rejected. JSON decoder additionally rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated request -> structured filters -> normalized query and catalog -> synonym/typo expansion -> all-term matching -> scored, deterministically sorted results

behavior.normalization: Unicode casefold, accent folding, punctuation tokenization, conservative terminal-s removal and fixed English stop words
behavior.intent_matching: Fixed general-product synonym groups; one deterministic difflib correction at similarity >= 0.80 for unknown tokens of length >= 4
behavior.ranking: Best field match per term: name 4, tags 3, category 2, description 1; exact confidence 100, synonym 85, typo 70. Sum scores, break ties by product ID.
behavior.matching: All meaningful query terms must match; no silent broadening on no results. Blank or stop-word-only queries browse.
behavior.filters: Applied before typo vocabulary generation and ranking; total_matches counted before limit
behavior.cli: One JSON object; success exit 0; validation, malformed JSON, usage and file errors exit 2
behavior.providers: No LLM step; deterministic local logic only
